subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this default-off, installation-pseudonymous message lifecycle ledger as a permanent core audit and privacy contract?
rationale: Tests cannot decide whether the durable operator metadata, same-database HMAC correlation model, coverage limits, and long-lived config, RPC, and schema surfaces are desired product policy.

options.title: Adopt the bounded contract
options.body: Approve the documented best-effort coverage and correlation model after real behavior and upgrade proof is posted.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Reduce event coverage or stored correlation fields before establishing the permanent contract.

options.title: Decline core message auditing
options.body: Keep message investigation in diagnostics, exporters, and channel tooling rather than adding the durable core ledger.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented best-effort coverage and correlation model after real behavior and upgrade proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing audit foundation and linked product proposal give the strongest available contract-ownership signal.
